headerText: A/C trains suspended between Jay St-MetroTech and Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr
descriptionText: Due to track work, A and C trains are suspended between Jay St-MetroTech and Atlantic Av-Barclays Ctr in both directions. Use the F train as an alternative. Allow extra travel time.

headerText: Heavy rain causing surface route delays
descriptionText: Heavy rain is causing delays on all surface routes. Allow 10–20 additional minutes of travel time. Subway service is not affected.

headerText: Planned work: 1 train running express on weekends
descriptionText: The 1 train will skip stops at 18th St, 28th St and 50th St in both directions during weekend service. Service changes are in effect from Saturday 12:01 AM to Sunday 11:59 PM.
